ns2:section.sectionText: NOTE: FSHN499 will not meet the first night at Oak Brook Multi-University Center. The first night of class will be held online. You will be contacted prior to the first night of class with course details and online course login information. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Microphone and high speed Internet access is required for the course. Software is provided for access to the course. This section is restricted to AGED students.
